title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a salt-water experiment sheet to Session 1
body:
## Problem
Session 1 mentions that sea water holds a block higher, but gives no hands-on sheet.

## Context
A home experiment with a bucket, a block and salt makes the idea real.

## Expected outcome
A one-page experiment sheet with a table to fill in and the predicted draft for each salt amount.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Predictions come from the lesson functions
- [ ] A note on why measurements differ

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: free-surface effect in tanks
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. A partly filled tank reduces GM, which the shipped code ignores.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Generalise the wet-section function to any hull polygon
body:
## Problem
`wet_section` only handles a rectangle.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 2: round-bilge and V-shaped hulls need the same clipping and centroid code applied to any polygon.

## Expected outcome
A function that takes a polygon and returns the water line and centre of buoyancy, with tests against the rectangle results.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Same results as the existing code for a rectangle
- [ ] A test with a triangle against an analytic result

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: a heeling ship with a righting-arm area
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a ship section heeling with G, B, M and a GZ curve with shaded area; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A non-rectangular hull and two loading cases
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
